title: Intelligence contacts tell Kurt his analysis is about 80% right
summary: Kurt Metzger tells of Intelligence contacts tell Kurt his analysis is about 80% right, about recent years at unspecified, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: raise your hand if someone from somewhere like DoD or D uh was it did someone from one of three layer agencies can maybe met you somewhere and go hey I just want to tell you like you're about 80% right your analysis

plain: Kurt Metzger, a guest on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2025, says that someone from a government body such as the Department of Defense, the US military's headquarters department, or another secretive agency met him and told him his analysis was about 80% right. He tells it as something that happened to him, and asks whether others in the room had the same experience. If true, it would mean insiders are quietly confirming outsiders' theories.
